verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents automatic identity stitching ('amends all previous records associated with this user based on anonymous cookie-based id') and a Profile Builder that aggregates identify-event traits into warehouse profiles, with a custom JavaScript function for defining resolution logic — giving a documented, somewhat configurable stitching mechanism. However, evidence never explicitly addresses cross-device merging (only cookie-based anonymous-to-known linkage) nor gives detailed configuration options/rules beyond 'write your own JS function', and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of stitching accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit cross-device identity resolution documentation, detailed configurable rule examples, and independent verification of stitching behavior.
